name: darkest_den
comment: Den of Evil arena: one small chamber, Blizzard's cave room caveecrow (about half the size of the old Den chamber). The player arrives by waypoint on the west side; the plugin spawns the waves and Corpsefire to the east. Rooms are 24x24 tiles.

extra_objects.comment: WaypointOutsideAct1 (objpreset Act 1 Index 52). Its HD look is the prefab below, placed as in the game's act1/outdoors/waypoint map (object at sub-tile 14,14 -> prefab at 37,38).
